admission.justification: The writer base side and the quality check each choose comparison bases in different files, so one statement keeps them from judging against one parent only.

applicability: Memory writes and memory-quality checks run while the memory tree is mid-merge.
conditions: MERGE_HEAD exists beside HEAD in the memory work tree.
exclusions: A tree with no merge in progress, which compares against its recorded base only.
statement: During a merge the knowledge writer and the memory-quality check validate against both merge parents: HEAD and MERGE_HEAD are both comparison bases.
